pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions are characterized by irregular polygonal geometry with rounded vertices and softened pixel-level edge gradients. Patch area is non-uniform, transitioning from larger, wider polygons on the lower flank to more compressed, elongated forms toward the upper neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light pelage forms a continuous, interconnected topological graph. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radiate intersections. Pixel thickness of the corridors is relatively uniform throughout the mid-flank area with no observed terminations or significant narrowing.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck and shoulder displays a continuous 1D geometric contour with low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations against the background.
